tools.name: ask_user
tools.description: Ask the user one or more clarification questions when you are blocked on a decision the user must make (the request is genuinely ambiguous, you cannot pick a sensible default, or proceeding without their answer would force a costly rewrite). BUNDLE every pending question into a single ask_user call — never ask one at a time when more are coming. For each question, propose 2-4 mutually exclusive option strings; the renderer adds an "其他 (自定义)" free-text fallback automatically. Do NOT use this tool when a sensible default exists, or when the answer is obvious from context, or merely to confirm something — pick the obvious choice and proceed instead. Returns `{ answers: [{ question, answer }] }` where `answer` is either the option string the user chose or the free text they typed.

questions.description: List of clarification questions to ask the user, all surfaced together in one panel. 1-4 questions; combine related concerns rather than splitting them into multiple calls.

question.description: The complete question to ask the user. Should be specific, end with a question mark, and avoid forward references like "see option A".

options.description: Up to 4 distinct candidate answers. Keep each option short (1-6 words) and mutually exclusive. Do NOT include an "其他/Other" option — the renderer always shows a free-text input below the options for that.

tools.name: fill_current_page_form
tools.description: Batch-fill form fields on the active in-app browser/project page. Provide an array of field entries with selectors or refs from read_current_page and the text to enter. This is the built-in replacement for chrome/playwright browser MCP form helpers and a convenience wrapper around interact_current_page action=batch_input.

tab_id.description: Optional workspace tab id from manage_workspace_tabs. Omit to use the active page tab.

selector.description: CSS selector of the input, textarea, or select element.

text.description: Text or option value to set.

append.description: If true, append instead of replacing.

tools.name: interact_current_page
tools.description: Operate the active in-app browser/project page. Actions: click, input, select, batch_input, extract, evaluate, hover, focus, press_key (real keyboard), scroll, wait, wait_for, find (semantic element lookup), navigate, reload, back, forward, resize (viewport), emulate (print/screen media, prefers-color-scheme, prefers-reduced-motion, user agent, mobile viewport/device scale), batch (multiple actions in one round trip). For wait_for, selector/ref/text are evaluated in the current document, while state/url wait across navigations. Action "emulate" is the built-in replacement for chrome-devtools-mcp "emulate". These built-in page tools replace chrome/playwright browser MCP for navigation, screenshots, console/network reads, viewport resizing/emulation, DOM inspection, and script evaluation; use external browser MCP only for capabilities the built-in surface lacks (CDP-level network interception, performance tracing, or CI browser matrices). Use selectors or stable refs from read_current_page.

action.description: Action to perform on the active page. "emulate" is the built-in replacement for chrome-devtools-mcp "emulate" (media, color scheme, reduced motion, user agent, mobile viewport).

tab_id.description: Optional workspace tab id from manage_workspace_tabs. Omit to use the active page tab.

selector.description: CSS selector of the target element. Selectors come from read_current_page or action "find".

ref.description: Stable element ref from read_current_page/find (e1, e2, ...). Prefer it over fragile CSS selectors.

text.description: Required for input. Text to type into the target field.

append.description: For input/batch_input: append text instead of replacing the current value.

top.description: Required for scroll. Vertical scroll offset in pixels.

left.description: Optional horizontal scroll offset in pixels for scroll.

value.description: For select: the option value to select.

label.description: For select: the visible text label of the option to select.

index.description: For select: the zero-based index of the option to select.

fields.description: Required for batch_input. Array of {selector|ref, text, append?} objects.

offset.description: For extract: zero-based character offset to start reading from.

max_chars.description: For extract: maximum characters to return per page. Default 60000.

script.description: For evaluate: JavaScript expression, async function, or statements to run in the page. Async and top-level await are supported; the result is serialized.

role.description: For find: accessible role filter (button, link, textbox, checkbox, ...).

url.description: For navigate: target URL. For wait_for: URL substring to wait for.

state.description: For wait_for: document load state to wait for.

limit.description: For find: maximum matches to return (default 20, max 50).

ignore_cache.description: For reload: bypass the HTTP cache.

width.description: For resize/emulate: viewport width in CSS pixels. emulate accepts 320-4096; a missing dimension keeps the current viewport size.

height.description: For resize/emulate: viewport height in CSS pixels. emulate accepts 320-4096; a missing dimension keeps the current viewport size.

reset.description: For resize/emulate: reset the agent viewport and page emulation back to the panel defaults.

media.description: For emulate: emulated CSS media type. Use "print" to verify print styles.

user_agent.description: For emulate: override the page user agent. Must be non-empty.

device_scale_factor.description: For emulate: device pixel ratio from 0.5 to 4 (default 1 when a viewport is supplied).

actions.description: Required for batch. Array of action objects, each with an "action" field and its own parameters.

tools.name: manage_workspace_tabs
tools.description: List, switch to, or close tabs in the user's right-side workspace panel. Switching tabs retargets your UI tools: after activating a terminal tab, read_active_terminal / write_active_terminal operate on that terminal; after activating a browser or project tab, read_current_page / interact_current_page operate on that page (pass its id as tab_id when several pages are open). Actions: "list" returns every open tab with id, kind, title and its url/cwd/file_path/project_id; "activate" focuses an existing tab (by tab_id from a previous list, or by kind plus url/cwd/file_path) and reveals the panel — use it to show a terminal or web page to the user, or to retarget your terminal/page tools; it never creates tabs (use open_workspace_tab for that); "close" closes one tab (closing the last tab hides the panel, and closing a terminal tab kills its session).

action.description: What to do with the workspace tabs.

tab_id.description: Exact tab id from a previous "list" result. Wins over kind/matchers.

kind.description: Tab kind filter; with url/cwd/file_path it locates one specific tab, without them it targets the first tab of that kind.

url.description: browser only: match an existing tab by URL (same rule as open dedupe).

cwd.description: terminal only: match an existing terminal tab by working directory.

file_path.description: document only: match an existing document tab by file path.

tools.name: open_project_app
tools.description: Ask WorldBase shell to open an existing project in the managed app UI. Prefer this over launching an unmanaged preview server yourself.

mode.description: How the shell should open the project. Use embed by default; use window only when the user explicitly wants a standalone window.

tools.name: open_workspace_tab
tools.description: Open a tab in the user's right-side workspace panel next to the chat. Use kind "folder" with root_path to bind a code directory; kind "document" with file_path to open one document (PDF/Excel/Word/...); kind "browser" with url to open a web page the user can watch and you can operate with the page tools (read_current_page / interact_current_page, including screenshots, diagnostics, navigation and viewport resize); kind "terminal" to open a shell terminal you can operate with read_active_terminal / write_active_terminal; kind "project" with project_id to open one of the user's developed apps (you can operate its UI with the page tools). The panel stays visible after the reply finishes.

root_path.description: folder only: absolute directory path to bind as the code workspace root. Omit to let the user pick a folder interactively.

file_path.description: document only: absolute path of the document file to open as its own tab. Reopening a bound path just focuses its tab.

url.description: browser only: URL to load in the embedded browser tab.

project_id.description: project only: id of one of the user's developed apps (from list_projects). Its UI opens in the workspace panel.

active_file_path.description: Optional: file path (relative to root_path for folder tabs) to select after opening.

tools.name: read_current_page
tools.description: Inspect the active in-app browser/project page. Modes: "interactive" (default) returns title, URL, readable text, interactive elements with stable refs/selectors, and form fields; "article" returns readability-style primary content as markdown; "search_results" extracts result titles/URLs/snippets from a search engine page; "screenshot" returns a current viewport (or full-page) image for visual verification; "diagnostics" returns console output, uncaught errors, recent fetch/XHR/resource activity, viewport and history state. These built-in page tools replace chrome/playwright browser MCP for navigation, screenshots, console/network reads, viewport changes, DOM inspection, and script evaluation; use external browser MCP only for capabilities the built-in surface lacks (CDP-level network interception, performance tracing, or CI browser matrices). When web_search/web_fetch reports access "blocked"/"degraded", open the page with open_workspace_tab(kind="browser") and read it here with mode "article".

mode.description: interactive (default): DOM snapshot with refs and form selectors. article: readable primary-content text. search_results: title/URL/snippet list from the current search page. screenshot: image of the page for visual design verification. diagnostics: console/errors/network/viewport state.

max_chars.description: Maximum characters from the live page text preview to return (interactive mode). Default 8000, maximum 60000.

tab_id.description: Optional workspace tab id from manage_workspace_tabs. Omit to use the active page tab.

full_page.description: screenshot only: capture the full scrollable page instead of the visible viewport.

max_width.description: screenshot only: maximum image width in pixels (default 1280, max 4096).

format.description: screenshot only: image format. Default png.

clear_diagnostics.description: diagnostics only: clear the buffered console/error/network entries after returning the current snapshot.

tools.name: save_current_page_as_document
tools.description: Save the full text of the active in-app browser/project page as a document artifact. Long pages are extracted in chunks; if a safety cap is reached the result includes truncated/expected length metadata plus guidance for reading the remainder. Returns an artifact_id that can be read with read_document in chunks, searched, and revisited later. Useful for long pages or when the model needs to search or repeatedly reference the page content. Prefer this built-in tool over external browser MCP when you need a durable, searchable copy of page content.

selector.description: Optional CSS selector to extract only a portion of the page. Defaults to the full page body.

ref.description: Optional stable ref from read_current_page to extract only that element.

file_name.description: Optional display name for the saved document. Defaults to "current-page".

tab_id.description: Optional workspace tab id from manage_workspace_tabs. Omit to use the active page tab.
